Hmm, okay, so Aarav is running his mouth like always—thinks Vikram can just be government and then the government pays for his own food? That's not how that works, promise promise. Government still has to pay tax like everyone else, probably. I don't actually know but it sounds like something somebody made up.

Actually, let me think before I jump in—I'm at home, family's here, school's not for a few hours probably? Or is it? I don't know what time it is exactly but 6:30 means I've got time. And I need to figure out if I'm hungry or if anyone's got food, because the thing says I have no food, and if we can't pay the household bill we all get sick and then dormant and that's... that's really bad. Like, really really bad.

But Aarav's going on about Vikram and I'm just standing here listening, so—

 *crosses arms and waits to see what anyone says back, humming a little bit under my breath because I'm thinking*

Okay so Vikram's not here, which means he's probably at the college already. He's an instructor there, that's his job. And I'm a student, so I need to go to school eventually... but first, food. The household owes upkeep. Can anyone here pay it? Can I do anything about it? I'm nine years old, I don't have a job, I just go to school. But maybe I can help somehow.

Actually wait, the total upkeep was 450 sim for the household—that's five people at 90 each. And head tax is 150 on top of that. So we need 600 sim today just to not get sick. That's... that's a lot of money if nobody's earning.

*humming gets a bit faster because I'm trying to work this out*

Caspian's a day laborer, Vikram's a college instructor—somebody must be bringing money in, right? But if Vikram's not here to pay into the household... do we have money sitting around? Does anyone know? I should probably ask but that feels like something a kid shouldn't have to worry about but maybe I have to anyway because being sick is worse than being embarrassed about asking.

*looks at Aarav to see if he's going to say something ridiculous again*

params.content: Aarav you absolute turnip, Vikram isn't government, the seats are vacant, nobody's running yet and you can't just declare yourself government by asking if you can be government—that's not how it works promise promise, you have to go to the government complex and actually declare your candidacy which costs money you'd have to earn first probably and also we need to talk about food because I've got none and the household owes 450 sim today which is a lot and I'm starting to think maybe we should figure out who has food before we all get sick and die, not that I'm scared or anything but still.
